q2_gaps: a bare MASS-NOUN subject inside a whenever-rule consequent ("salt-bloom blooms in the tide-pools"): the bare-kind-filler licence is stated for non-specific OBJECTS ('pays tax', 'grows wheat') and bare-plural subjects mint group witnesses, but nothing licenses (or forbids) a bare mass kind symbol as the per-occurrence subject of the derived event

no namespace separation between a verb-derived event class and a same-spelled noun kind: mandatory compound decomposition gives (Inheritance salt_bloom bloom) while the verb 'blooms' lemmatizes to the same event class in (Member (sk_bloom $e1) bloom), so every derived blooming event also becomes a member of the noun-kind salt_bloom inherits from — both atoms are individually required by the instruction set
notes: Routing is correct (indefinite trigger subject sends bare 'when' to the whenever machinery even with a definite object), the definite plural 'the tide-pools' takes a top-level GroupOf witness that legitimately licenses the sk_* constant appearing in the premise, and it is reused for coreference in the consequent's Location. All three compound genera are emitted with their noun modifiers withheld, and fill/bloom take Patient by the change-of-state tests.
